metadata.case_name: GURUNG DHAR BAHADUR v. PO ON CONSTRUCTION ENGINEERING LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.education_level: secondary school (according to the Plaintiff's witness statement) or primary 5 (according to the Jt Ortho Report)

injuries.description: Fracture of right transverse processes of the lumbar spine (L1, L2 and L3); status post healed fracture with residual back pain
injuries.body_part: lumbar spine (right transverse processes of L1, L2 and L3)
source: repeat x-ray of the back performed on 15 December 2007 revealed fracture of right transverse processes of the lumbar spine (L1, L2 and L3)
"[back] pain status post fracture transverse process of [the Plaintiff’s] lumbar spine (L1, L2 and L3)"

manifestations.description: Pain radiating to thighs / sharp pain radiating to right leg
Limited lumbar range of movement (reduced flexion and extension)
Reduced walking tolerance / difficulty walking for prolonged periods
Difficulty in bending down and lifting heavy weights

treatments_received: physiotherapy (27 sessions; started 6 February 2008; discharged 18 August 2008)
inpatient orthopaedic ward admission (7 days: 19 January 2008 to 24 January 2008)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (PSLA) — award assessed by the court at HK$230000.00

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to play football twice a week and unable to participate in traditional Nepalese dancing during festivals as before the Accident
Loss of earning capacity: court awarded HK$54000.00 (equivalent to 6 months' earnings at notional reduced rate of HK$9,000.00 per month)
